services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services for Sheffield & Chesterfield
services_subhead: From single-room refreshes to full commercial repaints, we handle every job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert preparation, quality finishes, and minimal disruption. We handle walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls—all done cleanly and on time.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect your home's exterior with durable, weather-resistant paint. We prep surfaces properly and work in all seasons to keep your property looking sharp.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Precise hanging of modern or classic wallpapers, textured coverings, and specialty finishes. Our technique ensures seamless joins and long-lasting results.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Painting
services.desc: Quick turnarounds for shops, offices, and businesses. We work around your opening hours and site requirements to minimise disruption.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and built-in cabinetry painted to a high finish. We strip, prime, and paint with the care your woodwork deserves.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Murals
services.desc: Feature walls, bespoke colours, and creative paint effects. If you can imagine it, we can bring it to life with professional technique.

about_pullquote: We do the job right because we'd want the same in our own homes.
about_para_1: 1st Class Painting and Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Sheffield and Chesterfield for over 20 years. We started as a two-person team and grew through word-of-mouth and repeat customers who trusted us to get the details right—on time and on budget. Today we're a small, experienced crew who still treat every job as though it's our own.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on thorough preparation, quality paint, and respect for your space. We don't cut corners on prep work or use cheap materials. Most of our new customers come from existing ones who've recommended us to neighbours and friends. We keep our pricing fair and our communication clear—no surprises, no excuses.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield and Chesterfield Homeowners Say

reviews.text: Needed the whole sitting room and hallway redecorated before Christmas. Dave and the lads came in, moved everything carefully, and got the job done in two days. Walls are perfectly smooth, no mess left behind. Really impressed with the quality and would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a quote from three other painters but chose 1st Class. Explained why they'd do things a certain way, gave us a fair price, and stuck to it. Did our kitchen and bathroom—the finish on the woodwork is excellent. Actually cared about getting it right, not just rushing through.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Our shop needed a revamp and we needed it fast. They understood we couldn't close for days on end, worked around our hours, and the whole thing looked fresh in under a week. Professional outfit, proper insurance, and they cleaned up after themselves. Cheers, lads.
reviews.author: Rajesh M.
